summary.intent: Manage the final 3 phases of milestone v1.1 (phases 56-58) using the GSD manager dashboard, parallelizing discuss/plan/execute across phases, while concurrently exploring a strategic pivot idea (agent-native ZK storage) for the next milestone.
summary.outcome: Phases 56 and 57 were discussed and planned (both PASSED plan-checker), phase 56 execution launched in a background worktree, docs PR #539 opened and merged, and a Socratic exploration of agent-native ZK storage produced 4 planning artifacts (1 note, 2 seeds, 1 research question). Phase 58 remains blocked on phase 56 landing.

repo: Background agents running in worktrees CAN nest subagents — the prior belief that plan-checker/worktree-isolation would silently break was wrong; corrected in memory.

Web3Auth is not used server-side at all; Web3AuthVerifierService exists but is never called — the server is agnostic to where the keypair originates, making wallet-native agent tenancy cheap on the existing substrate.
The JWT already carries an optional scope[] claim — a ready hook for future capability-scoping without schema changes.

SIWE wallet auth path already exists (/auth/identity/wallet → /auth/login) and vault init is client-supplied (ownerPublicKey + rootIpnsName from caller, no human gates like MFA for new users), making agent-as-first-class-tenant feasible today.

Write delegation leaks the raw Ed25519 IPNS signing key — deleting the share_keys row does NOT cryptographically revoke write access; the agent can keep signing IPNS directly and the TEE keeps republishing.
Read revocation is lazy (executeLazyRotation only fires on the sharer's next write) and folder-coarse with no TTL or per-file scope — a security gap for hostile-agent threat models.
CipherBox uses CIDv1 (cid-version=1 on Kubo add); UnpinDto.CID_REGEX already covers both v0+v1 — phase 57's fix is just extracting that existing regex onto RegisterCidDto, not creating a new one.
pin/add does not interpolate the CID into the URL (CID comes from Kubo's response); only pin/rm and cat endpoints need URL-encoded CIDs.

The plan-checker caught that D-01 'journal-on-exhaustion' assumed a JournalOp variant that doesn't exist in the codebase — corrected to return EIO on retry exhaustion (D-01a); journal path deferred as tracked idea.

x402 demand is genuinely uncertain — research produced contradictory findings (accelerating with 100M+ payments vs contracting ~77-90% off Nov 2025 peak); treat as unresolved before betting milestone scope on it.

x402 cannot be the storage meter — no request exists to attach a 402 to for idle per-GB-month stored data; it can only meter discrete operations and is best positioned as a prepaid-credit/egress settlement rail alongside Stripe.

code.finding: Web3Auth verifier is never invoked server-side; server is agnostic to key origin — wallet-native agent auth requires no new server auth logic.
Folder publish already has a correct IPNS Conflict re-resolve+retry loop — this is the reference pattern to extract into a shared publish_with_cas_retry helper for phase 56.
Per-file IPNS publish swallows Conflict as success (bug) — one of the two sites to fix in phase 56 via the shared CAS helper.
Bin IPNS publish swallows Conflict as success (bug) — second site to fix in phase 56 via the shared CAS helper.

workflow: GSD manager supports parallel planning via git worktrees — two independent phases can be planned simultaneously by creating separate worktrees (cipher-box-wt-phase56, cipher-box-wt-phase57) off the same base commit, each on its own feature branch.
To run parallel planning worktrees, park the main tree in a detached HEAD state (git checkout --detach origin/main) so both feature branches remain free for their respective worktrees.

For phases that are tightly scoped from ROADMAP todos with no open design decisions, it is valid to write CONTEXT.md directly without manufacturing gray-area questions — discuss workflow allows this path.

When discussing phases that are pure hardening (no new behaviors), cross-reference the source todos by name against the ROADMAP to confirm scope boundaries and exclude false-positive todo matches belonging to other phases.
The docs PR should be opened and merged before rebasing feature branches off main so that phase-scoped branches include the roadmap entries in their base.
1Password SSH commit signing can wedge and return 'failed to write commit object' — retry resolves it once the biometric prompt is approved; never bypass with --no-gpg-sign.
GSD commit helper can produce a false negative (staged but no visible error) when commit fails — always follow up with git log to verify the commit actually landed.

friction: 1Password SSH signing wedged mid-session returning 'failed to write commit object' — required detecting the failure via git log (not from the commit helper output) and retrying with a separate signed commit.
GSD commit helper gave no visible failure signal when the commit didn't land — files appeared staged but no commit object was created; silent failure made diagnosis slower.
The prior memory record that background agents cannot nest subagents was incorrect, causing unnecessary inline-plan framing at session start before being corrected mid-session.

Background adversarial research on x402 produced contradictory findings across lenses (accelerating vs deflating 77-90% off peak) — could not be resolved within the session, leaving a key strategic assumption uncertain.
Phase 57 branch had to be created as an isolated branch off the roadmap commit (not yet merged main) to avoid polluting PR #539 — required extra branch management and a planned rebase after merge.
open_items: Phase 56 execution running in background worktree (cipher-box-wt-phase56) — result not yet confirmed; needs PR after execution completes.
Phase 57 planned and PASSED but not yet executed — waiting for phase 56 to land (or can execute independently since they touch different code: Rust/FUSE vs apps/api).
Phase 58 (IPNS Signature-Verify Coverage) blocked on phase 56 landing — still needs discuss, plan, and execute.
Docs branch with explore artifacts (note, 2 seeds, research questions) was written but final commit/push to docs branch was the last action in the transcript — confirm those landed.
mkdir re-arm consolidation (MkdirConflict event-channel, currently platform-duplicated) noted during phase 56 discussion but intentionally deferred out of phase scope.

Agent-native ZK storage milestone (supersedes proposed productivity-suite M4) — needs formal milestone scoping, design-partner LOI before committing full build; validation-gated items include which payload/customer actually pulls, x402 real trajectory, and EU-AI-Act timing (Aug 2026).
Eager, scoped, time-boxed, cryptographically-revocable capabilities — identified as both a security fix for existing consumers and the core agent-native moat; not yet phased or scheduled.
MCP server over the headless SDK — identified as the primary agent distribution channel and demo vehicle for design-partner validation; not yet scoped into a phase.
